content.text:
Reviewed all touched files. This change is purely a UI refactor:

- `credits.tsx` deleted — a display-only React component that rendered brand/garment text as `{children}` (React auto-escapes) and had an `onOpenItem` callback that mapped 1:1 to a client-side `router.push('/closet/${id})`. Its removal removes a route, not a control.
- `stylist-view.tsx` — drops the `Credits` component and its `onOpenItem` prop; restyles the existing `onRegenerate` button (Tailwind class swap only, same handler wiring). No new sinks. The retained `Link href={\`/outfits/${look.id}\`}` and `<WhyQuote name={look.name} why={look.why} />` still render as escaped text nodes / Next.js Link — unchanged from before.
- `stylist.tsx` — only removes passing `onOpenItem={(id) => router.push(\`/closet/${id}\`)}`. No new data flow.
- `why-quote.tsx` — Tailwind class change (`translate-y-0.5` → `-translate-y-px`) on a decorative `<span aria-hidden>`. No behavior change.
- Test files — mirror the API surface change.

No new entry points, sinks, auth checks, parsers, allowlists, IaC, logs, or observability changes. Nothing to trace source→sink on; the diff strictly removes UI surface plus one CSS nudge.
